patches.title: No Detour After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the transformation location without any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, heating, or cooling.

patches.title: Skip Empty Returns
patches.principle: After placing one object, if the previous location is empty, move to the next open surface in the initial scan order.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for additional objects after placing the first.
